description: The chart represents the distribution of different stimulus types, showing the proportion of each category. The chart is divided into 8 slices, each representing a distinct stimulus type. The slices are labeled with their corresponding categories and percentages. The largest slice, colored red, represents "Event Posting" at approximately 39.4%, while the other slices represent "Press Release" (18.7%, yellow), "External News Article" (18.1%, green), "Interview" (8.8%, dark blue), "Organizational Report" (7.7%, light purple), "Organizational Website" and "Intra-agency news article" (both 4.9%, purple and light blue respectively), "Email" (2.7%, light green), and "Social Media Post" (1.1%, orange). The percentages are labeled outside the chart, next to their corresponding categories, and the chart does not include a legend. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest slice starting from the right side of the chart.
